The suit alleged that the committee improperly used nonprofit donations, including by paying more than $1 million to the Trump International Hotel in Washington during inauguration week. Ivanka Trump called the inquiry wasteful and said the hotel had been told to charge a fair-market rate. The Associated Press reported that she testified but did not publish an answer shown to be knowingly false or report a perjury charge or finding. The documented event is her testimony in a civil case about alleged inaugural-fund payments; it does not substantiate the title’s claim that she lied under oath.
